note: Executable hardware-software pin-map contract consumed by Acadia-OS device trees and Acadia-HAL platform tables. Changes are cross-repo breaking events; bump board_revision on any edit. UART allocation authority: doc/uart-allocation.md (T-P15 — this map is the machine-readable projection).

pico_uart.hil_verify: device node name for the uart2 overlay (expected /dev/ttyAMA2)
pico_uart.note: T-P15: GPIO0/1 carry RP1 UART2 via the upstream uart2 overlay (HAT ID-EEPROM function of GPIO0/1 is unused on this board — the module EEPROM is on I2C1). The Pi 5 console lives on the dedicated debug-header UART /dev/ttyAMA10 (meta-raspberrypi SERIAL_CONSOLES), which is RESERVED; /dev/ttyAMA0 (GPIO14/15) is HAL's RS-485 port. Consumers resolve nodes through HAL accessors, never hard-coded paths.

electrical_limits.note: All GPIO are 3.3V logic; do not expose to >3.3V without level shifting.

do_not_touch.note: Header pins NOT in gpio[] are reserved; module code must never drive them.
